tools.name: list_audio_tools

tools.name: get_upload_url
tools.description: Get a presigned URL to upload an audio file directly to R2 storage.

tools.name: upload_audio
tools.description: Upload a small audio file (under 1MB) via base64 encoding.

tools.name: process_audio
tools.description: Process an uploaded audio file. Main entry point for all SonicAura features.

tools.name: extract_vocals
tools.description:
Extract the vocals from a song — a convenient shortcut for process_audio
    with task_type='2stems'. Returns two stems: the isolated vocals and the
    instrumental. Ideal for a cappella, karaoke, covers or vocal practice.

    Args:
        source_key: The source_key returned by upload_audio or ge

tools.name: check_task_status

tools.name: get_my_credits
tools.description: Check the current user's remaining credits.

tools.name: check_service_status
tools.description: Check if the SonicAura audio service is currently available.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_upload_url · Private data: get_upload_url, upload_audio, process_audio · Public sink: get_upload_url, upload_audio, submit_separation · Destructive: extract_vocals.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_upload_url · Private data: get_upload_url, upload_audio, process_audio · Public sink: get_upload_url, upload_audio, submit_separation · Destructive: extract_vocals

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
